plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure, aligning with capital preservation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 25%, to favor income and stability.
Buy CRM at 5% of the book, adding a top-quality name from the scanner.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a steady, low-drawdown approach.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure while maintaining a small allocation.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Buy COIN at 4% of the book, adding a strong scanner setup.
Buy CRM at 4% of the book, adding another strong scanner setup.
This plan balances risk and growth, blending broad index with quality tech.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing high-quality tech names. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a balanced growth outlook.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL, increasing its allocation to 6%, and add to SPAL, increasing its allocation to 6%, leaning into leveraged ETFs.
Buy COIN at 6% of the book, concentrating in a high-scoring scanner setup.
Buy CRM at 6% of the book, concentrating in another high-scoring scanner setup.
This plan aims for stretched growth by using leverage and concentrating in strong setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, with leveraged ETFs subject to decay and rebalancing, meaning substantial losses can occur quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure, prioritizing low drawdown.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30%, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce growth exposure and further de-risk the portfolio.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield and reliable income.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta names, focusing on income-generating ETFs. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
